findings.text: the two sides of this assertion move together - its left side is computed from the reading the test itself passed in, under the module's own FILL_CLOCK, and its right side is that same reading through the reader's accessor named by that same constant - so it cannot fail on a swap of FILL_CLOCK and WEEK_CLOCK at reckon/crew/budget_group.py:46-47, and that swap is caught only by the recorded literals at tests/test_budget_group_declaration.py:196-197, so this case proves the module reads the constant it names, not that the constant names the five-hour clock.

item_verdicts.diff: the reviewed pair base to head carries three commits - bb971efb adds the wallet-keyed figures and the declaration test, 7a9429f7 lands the plan, evidence and figure records, and 5d3f52e4 rebuilds the consumer onto the crew's own reading vocabulary after the first form required keys nothing in reckon writes; the single commit past the reviewed head, 73c5713a, touches two docs paths only and leaves reckon/crew/budget_group.py and tests/test_budget_group_declaration.py byte-identical to the reviewed head.
item_verdicts.done_when: read the node's stated measure against the landed change - the four sol-family lanes resolve to one wallet by count and by name (tests/test_budget_group_declaration.py:157-160), a lane declaring no wallet joins neither wallet (:167-171), the wallet's fill is its freshest member's rather than a stale lane's own (:195-196), a reading that cannot be aged supplies no wallet (:282-283), a week clock with no reset yields no pace rather than a guessed one (:296-298), an unobserved wallet reports no figure rather than a zero (:305-308), and the declared negative control reddens the census with the declared mutation verbatim on the first line of its log (2 failed, 10 passed, EXIT=1) - with the declarations themselves supplied by the node's host layer rather than by the schema, which declares the slot and states it supplies no value (reckon/schema/flight.yaml:469-476), carried as a reported follow-on rather than an edited file.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal - one budget_group per wallet, so a wallet's pace, bar and reserve are computed once per wallet rather than once per lane - is delivered by reckon/crew/budget_group.py:219 group_figures, which resolves the declared wallet's freshest ageable member reading at :291, takes that member's fill and week utilisation, and delegates the bar to bar_module.recommend(fill, 1.0).bar at :286 and the reserve to reserve_module.reserve_pct at :287, while a lane identifier is refused with the same ValueError group_position raises at :255, so a lane's share of a shared allowance has no entry point.
item_verdicts.manifest: the manifest reads complete with four commits and five changed paths - its tests name the reworked gate at 73c5713a with 62 passed, the cohort at 54 passed on both the dispatch base b453d7632 and the delivered head, and the declared negative control; every named log is on disk and names its revision, the module its import resolves to, and its exit code, and none of them reports a failure the node left unexplained.
item_verdicts.write_paths: every path in the node's base-to-head change is inside its declared fence - reckon/crew/budget_group.py, tests/test_budget_group_declaration.py, docs/plans/a-window-paces-the-lane.html, docs/evidence/archive/a-window-paces-the-lane-landed.html and docs/figures/a-window-paces-the-lane/wallet-figures.svg - and the three declared schema and flight paths are deliberately untouched because the slot already exists and the schema states it carries no value, a decision the manifest records in its evidence_inputs rather than leaving unstated.

justifications.durability: reverting the consumer to keys nothing writes reddens the fixture-anchored literals at tests/test_budget_group_declaration.py:196-197, dropping one lane's declaration reddens the review's own census case, and the unaged, no-reset and unobserved cases each assert an absent figure rather than a zero - the one assertion whose two sides both read the module's own constant is :242, named as the finding below.
justifications.evidence: I re-ran the named gate myself from the reviewed tree - 12 passed with import reckon resolving to that tree, recorded in recheck-declaration.log beside the node's own logs - the node's rework gate names its revision, its resolved module and its cwd, and the cohort runs 54 passed at both the base and the head, so the claims are checkable and each one checks out.
justifications.fit: the module reads the crew's own reader vocabulary (reckon/crew/window_reading.py periods five_hour and seven_day, each utilisation a fraction of its own window) and delegates each figure to the module that owns it (bar at reckon/crew/budget_group.py:286, reserve at :287), matching the surrounding idiom with no renamed symbols - but it is a second figures entry beside reckon/budget.py:1969 group_pace and nothing calls it yet, which is the reservation both this review and the plan's wiring note carry.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the wallet-keyed figures are real and the per-lane path is refused (ValueError at reckon/crew/budget_group.py:255), and the declarations they read are real in the host layer, which names codex-sub on the four sol-family lanes; the reservation is that group_figures has no production caller yet, which the plan's own section records as wiring left to a later node.
justifications.scope_discipline: the change touches five files, all five inside the eight declared write paths, the untouched schema and flight paths are reported in evidence_inputs rather than silently skipped, and no neighbouring module was reformatted or renamed in passing.
